shellCommands.command: git status --short; cat package.json; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.next -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100

for f in lib/data.ts next.config.ts app/catalog/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx tsconfig.json; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; git diff; ls node_modules/next/package.json && grep '"version"' node_modules/next/package.json
cd node_modules/next; ls dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "unstable_prefetch\|runtime prefetch\|prefetch=\"unstable_forceStale\"\|unstable_instant" dist/docs docs 2>/dev/null | head -30
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs; grep -rli "prefetch" . | head -30; grep -rn "unstable_instant\|runtime\b.*prefetch\|prefetch.*runtime" . | head -30

(npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s 'localhost:3123/catalog?category=sale' | grep -o 'Products on sale\|Canvas Tote\|Loading category' | sort -u; curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'href="/catalog?category=[a-z]*"'; pkill -f "next start" ; git diff --stat

npx next start -p 3124 >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 & P=$!; sleep 5; curl -s 'localhost:3124/catalog?category=sale' | grep -o 'Products on sale\|Canvas Tote\|Loading category' | sort -u; curl -s localhost:3124/ | grep -o 'href="/catalog?category=[a-z]*"'; kill $P; git status --short
